@phoneTabHome.description: Tab bar: the first tab, the wallet's home screen. One word.

@phoneTabScan.description: Screen reader label of the round button in the middle of the tab bar that opens the QR scanner.

@phoneReview.description: Button on a card that needs the user's decision (an invoice, a contact's request); opens it for checking

@phoneLater.description: Quiet button that puts a needs-you card away for now

@phoneHomeRecent.description: Heading over the latest payments on Home

@phoneHomeSeeAll.description: Link at the end of Home's Recent heading; opens the Activity tab

@phoneHomeArriving.description: Info chip under Home's balance: the amount that is on its way in

@phoneHomeInSends.description: Quiet chip under Home's balance: the amount held by payments being sent

@phoneHomeSyncing.description: The status pill on Home while the node is catching up

@phoneHomeOffline.description: The status pill on Home when the wallet reaches neither the node nor Epicbox

@phoneHomeInvoiceTitle.description: Title of the card on Home when an invoice waits for the user's approval

phoneHomeInvoiceBody: {amount}. Nothing is paid until you approve.

@phoneHomeInvoiceBody.description: Body of the invoice card on Home; the amount may include a fiat value

@phoneHomeBalanceLastKnown.description: Caption over Home's balance when the figure is the last one known (no connection)

@phoneHomeBalanceSheetHint.description: Spoken name of Home's balance, which opens the sheet with every part of the balance

@phoneHomeFirstPayment.description: Empty Home, under the Recent heading: the title of the first, still empty row of the payment list. Names what will stand there. Two or three words, no full stop.

@phoneHomeFirstPaymentHint.description: Empty Home: the line under 'Your first payment' in the empty row. Says the payment shows in this place once it comes in. Short, no full stop.

phoneTourOffer: Want a quick tour of the wallet?

@phoneTourOffer.description: Toast shown once after the first unlock: offers the wallet tour. Short question.

@phoneTourOfferShow.description: Button on the tour offer toast: starts the tour. One or two words.

phoneBackupReminderText: Your recovery phrase is not backed up. Without it, a lost phone means a lost wallet.

@phoneBackupReminderText.description: Home slot card while the recovery phrase is not backed up: what is at risk, in two short sentences. Shown beside a shield icon, two lines at most.

@phoneBackupReminderAction.description: Gold link under the text of the recovery phrase reminder card on Home: opens the back-up. Two or three words.

@phoneChangeWaitingFor.description: Info chip under Home's balance: the change of a send comes back once it confirms; the send waits for the named contact to accept. 'confirming' is the word of the balance sheet's Confirming row. Keep short.

@phoneChangeWaitingReply.description: Info chip under Home's balance: as phoneChangeWaitingFor, for a send to an address with no contact name.

@phoneChangeWaitingReplies.description: Info chip under Home's balance: the change of several sends, none accepted yet. count is 2 or more.

@phoneChangeAbout.description: Info chip under Home's balance: the change of one send can be spent in about this many minutes. 'min' is minutes, abbreviated.

@phoneChangeNextIn.description: Info chip under Home's balance: the change of several sends; the soonest can be spent in about this many minutes.

@phoneChangeRowReply.description: Balance sheet, under a send's name in the Confirming part: the other side has not accepted the send yet.

phoneChangeRowBlock: waiting for a block · about {minutes} min

@phoneChangeRowBlock.description: Balance sheet, under a send's name: the payment is posted and waits for a block; its change can be spent in about this many minutes.

@phoneChangeRowConfirming.description: Balance sheet, under a send's name: the payment is in a block; its change can be spent in about this many minutes. count of target confirmations so far.

@phoneBalanceAvailableNow.description: Balance sheet: first row, the amount that can be spent now (the figure on Home).

@phoneBalanceArriving.description: Balance sheet: payments to this wallet that are in a block and confirming.

phoneBalanceChangeNote: A send spends whole coins. The rest comes back and can be spent after {target} confirmations, about {target} min after the payment is in a block. If a send is cancelled, the full amount comes back.

@phoneBalanceChangeNote.description: Balance sheet: note under the rows while a send's change is confirming. target is the confirmations setting; one block is about a minute.
